extracted.intended_audience: newspaper editors and general newspaper readers
extracted.subtask_description: A collection of Associated Press newswire dispatches (dated March 14, 1960) reporting on Cold War diplomacy, disarmament talks, military incidents and related international news intended for newspaper publication and syndication.

rubrics_metrics.name: embargo / advance release instructions
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicates specific advance or embargo times for distribution (e.g., 'ADVANCE FOR USE AT 7330 P.M.', 'ADVANCE FOR RELEASE AT 7230 P.M.').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These lines specify when material may be used or released by subscribing papers and broadcasters; they function as timing/control instructions for distribution. Example usages on the page: 'ADVANCE FOR USE AT 7330 P.M.', 'ADVANCE FOR RELEASE AT 7230 P.M.'

rubrics_metrics.name: AP dateline and byline formatting (newswire style)
rubrics_metrics.description: Articles include a dateline in all caps with city and date followed by '(AP)' and a hyphen, and a byline credit (reporter name or 'AP' credit).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shown throughout the file as e.g. 'GENEVA, MARCH 14 (AP)-...' and bylines like 'BY TOM OCHIL' or 'BY LEWIS GULICK'. This reflects AP-style conventions for identifying origin, date and authorship for syndicated dispatches.
